about.text: Fresh milk diluted with water and sprayed on squash or zucchini leaves to hold back powdery mildew. In Brazilian greenhouse tests it worked as well as the fungicides fenarimol and benomyl, which is why organic growers use it.

links.name: ECHO, milk as a fungicide (summarising Bettiol, Crop Protection 18, 1999)

sources.text: Sprayed by gardeners against mildew. My own rough estimate.

facts.v: Less infected leaf area with more milk; 10 % and above matched the fungicides (fenarimol, benomyl, water as comparison) in one summary (ECHO)
